Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app
items.description: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app
items.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot t…

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available acr…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI integration in M365 Copilot
items.description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
items.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live Light theme support
items.description: Presenting PowerPoint slides in Teams just got better. PowerPoint Live now supports light mode, giving presenters the option to present in light, dark, classic, or high contrast mode based on their preferences and system settings.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Planner: Task Details Side Pane experience
items.description: The Task Details Side Pane lets you view and edit task details in a side pane while keeping your Board, Grid, or My Tasks view visible. Update tasks without losing context or switching back and forth from modal dialogs.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
items.description: Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Block all identified external bots automatically from joining your meetings
items.description: Extending the admin controls provided for managing external AI bots and regulating their access to your meetings, we are adding the option to automatically block all identified bots.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
items.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
items.description: We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
items.description: We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint. Generate document from form (Preview) allows customers to create documents from a template by mapping data inputs to predefined template fields. Documents are generated as part of an automated flow and stored in SharePoint. This capability supports scenarios such as creati…

items.title: SharePoint: Admin Center - detailed report on Everyone except external user permissions
items.description: The new report provides SharePoint Advanced Management admins complete item level details of permissions granted to Everyone except external user and Everyone special SharePoint groups.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Security Detection Report in Teams Admin Center
items.description: A new Security Detection Report in the Teams admin center provides a centralized view of messaging security detections, including impersonation, malicious URLs, and weaponizable file types. Admins can review detection activity in one place and export detailed data to support investigation and response. This capability helps consolidate security signals for Teams messaging scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs and from text inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs and from text that appears inside images embedded in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files — such as scanned contracts in Word, screenshots of tables in Excel, or whiteboard photos in PowerPoint — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced cross-platform join via SIP for Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Enable Teams Rooms on Android to join third-party meetings via SIP, delivering seamless cross-platform interoperability. This capability ensures users can connect to external meeting services directly from Teams Rooms, maintaining a consistent and reliable meeting experience across diverse environments. Available on Teams Rooms Pro license.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Outlook: Share Word, Excel, and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
items.description: When working in an open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file, users will now be able to send a copy of the locally stored file by email through the new Outlook for Windows. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Capture voice notes in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
items.description: With a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, transform offline discussions into structured, actionable, and searchable content with voice notes in Copilot.

items.title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
items.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updates to Memory and Personalization in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Copilot now uses chat history to provide more relevant, contextual responses. Updated settings make it easier to view and manage what Copilot remembers and your personalization preferences.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Domain exclusion for web grounding
items.description: This feature will allow admins to specify a limited set of sites to exclude from web grounding in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Places: Microsoft Places Support to GCC cloud
items.description: Microsoft Places features will now be available in GCC cloud

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot
items.description: The Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot expedites answers for the most common workplace policy-related questions and takes action on key HR and IT related tasks, connecting employees to authorized knowledge bases and HR/IT systems of record for faster resolution time and a streamlined employee experience.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars
items.description: Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can chat privately in a separate chat from attendees. This chat is available to access before, during, and after the event.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity label grouping modernization
items.description: To help improve label usability and configuration, the sensitivity labeling scheme will be simplified to only consist of labels and label groupings. These new label groupings allow admins to better organize and categorize their labels (previously done via parent labels).

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Survey Owner role provides access to survey results
items.description: When a new program is being set up in Glint, there is now an option to designate Survey Owners. Those added as Survey Owners will be able to view and manage certain aspects of the program, as well as see the results when a survey in the program closes.

items.title: SharePoint: PowerShell support for brand fonts deletion
items.description: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing PowerShell support for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint Brand Center. With the new Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet, SharePoint administrators can remove brand font files that are no longer approved, licensed, or needed across their organization in SharePoint.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
items.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Enhanced Security Accounts Manager (sAM) Account Name support for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
items.description: Enhanced support for synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) with Microsoft Entra Domain Services is now in Public Preview. This feature allows sAMAccountName to be populated from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute in Microsoft Entra ID. Existing managed domains can enable the new synchronization behavior, while it is enabled by default for new managed domains. When enabled, exi…

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online in the event of classification failure
items.description: Default protection controls for Exchange Online is available in public preview. This release gives administrators fine-grained control to create DLP policies based on specific classification or text extraction failure types — such as timeout, throttling and other scan errors — rather than one blanket policy for all failure conditions.

items.title: Excel: Excel canvas
items.description: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC-High
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity a…

items.title: Microsoft 365: Organizational Data Service is now available in GCC-High
items.description: We’re excited to announce that Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is now available in the GCC-High (GCC-H) environment! Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service enables rapid ingestion of organizational/HR data through connectors from multiple HRIS systems using a single unified ingestion point. This service also provides organizational data for use across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 apps to power va…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls
items.description: Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails,…

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
items.description: The updated identity timeline provides security teams with a single chronological view of activity and alerts associated with an identity and its linked accounts. It normalizes activity from integrated Microsoft security products, including Microsoft Entra sign-ins, Microsoft Graph audit events, SaaS and cloud activity, and device logons. New fields and filters include Source table, Session ID, and Unique token iden…

items.product: Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 admin center, Microsoft Entra
items.description: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. This capability allows customers and ISV apps to do a point in time restore of Entra objects to a last known good state to a rolling historical 30-day point. Advanced recovery features are currently limited to the Entra admin portal, but some user recovery actions will…

items.title: Outlook for iOS and Android: Automatically apply email sensitivity labels from labeled attachments
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will automatically apply or recommend email sensitivity labels based on attached files with Microsoft Purview labels, enhancing consistent data protection and reducing manual labeling. This feature rolls out globally in late September 2026 with no admin action required.

items.title: Outlook for Mac: Sensitivity label recommendations and auto-labeling from attachments
items.description: Outlook for Mac will auto-apply or recommend Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels on emails based on attached files' labels, enhancing consistent information protection. This feature rolls out worldwide in late September 2026, requires no admin action, and helps reduce manual labeling while supporting compliance.

items.title: Enhanced Slide Navigation with Up and Down Arrow Keys in PPT Live
items.description: PowerPoint Live now allows slide navigation using Up and Down Arrow keys, enhancing presenter control. This update, rolling out globally from mid-August to early September 2026, requires no action but may prompt updates to training materials. Existing navigation methods remain unchanged.

items.title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Microsoft Entra permissions required for community and membership administration
items.description: Starting late September 2026, Microsoft Viva Engage will require Microsoft Entra permissions—Yammer Administrator role or Community Admin assignment—for community and membership management tasks previously allowed to Verified or Network Admins. Administrators should review and update role assignments accordingly.

items.title: Discover Cowork recommendations in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will offer contextual Cowork recommendations starting September 2026, helping eligible users access relevant tools with editable drafts. The feature is non-blocking, requires no admin action, and admins can disable Cowork access if needed. Training updates are recommended; no compliance issues noted.

items.title: Microsoft Defender XDR: DLP alerts will be set as behaviors by default
items.description: Microsoft Defender XDR will set Microsoft Purview DLP alerts as behaviors by default starting October 12, 2026, reducing alert volume while keeping DLP data accessible in Advanced Hunting and Purview. Administrators can disable this rule to retain DLP alerts in the Defender XDR incident queue.

items.title: General Availability of Power BI developer mode
items.description: Power BI developer mode and the PBIP file format are generally available, making PBIR the default report format in Power BI Desktop and service. This enhances source control, CI/CD, and programmatic development. PBIX remains primary, with no impact on report functionality. No user action is required.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Users can temporarily pause all notifications
items.description: Microsoft Teams will let users temporarily pause notifications for a chosen time to reduce interruptions and improve focus. This feature, available on desktop, web, and mobile, rolls out worldwide from mid-September to late October 2026. No admin action is needed.

items.title: Teams web client users will be redirected to teams.cloud.microsoft
items.description: Teams web users will be redirected from teams.microsoft.com to teams.cloud.microsoft by September 2026. This domain change won't affect features or existing links. Temporary admin control to disable redirect ends December 31, 2026. Organizations should update documentation and ensure network access to *.cloud.microsoft.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Prepare for Microsoft to disable unused or unsuccessful SMS first-factor sign-in
items.description: Microsoft will disable SMS first-factor sign-in in Microsoft Entra tenants with no successful or only unsuccessful SMS sign-ins in the past 30 days, starting mid-September 2026. SMS for MFA and password reset remains unaffected. Review and update authentication methods to ensure users have alternate sign-in options.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint: Configure user and survey data retention for deleted users in Viva Glint
items.description: Microsoft Viva Glint introduces a new admin control to configure retention or deletion of survey responses and identifiable data for deleted users, effective September 2026. This consolidates previous settings, aligns with Microsoft Entra deletion signals, and requires organizations to review and update policies accordingly.

items.title: (Updated) Pay-as-you-go consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
items.description: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing model for SharePoint storage overages, allowing admins to pay only for extra storage used beyond the quota. Available from November 2026, it’s opt-in, excludes education tenants, and requires Azure billing permissions. No user impact; manual storage purchase remains an option.

items.title: (Updated) Classic Outlook for Windows: User-initiated insights with Copilot
items.description: User-initiated insights with Copilot in classic Outlook for Windows allow users to highlight email text and prompt Copilot for contextual insights. Rolling out worldwide: Public Preview in May 2026, General Availability in October 2026. Feature is on by default for eligible users and integrates seamlessly without add-ins.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, enhancing visibility and providing AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins late September 2026 globally, with no changes to licensing or admin settings. No action is required, but communication to users is recommended.

items.title: (Updated) Discussion post previews coming to Viva Engage
items.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will introduce discussion post previews starting early September 2026, allowing users to review post formatting and presentation before publishing. This feature requires no admin setup, affects all Viva Engage users, and aims to improve communication quality. Organizations should inform users and update training accordingly.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms now supported in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees
items.description: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, allowing up to 100 breakout rooms per meeting. This feature, enabled by default, removes the previous 300-attendee limit and will roll out from July to September 2026. No action is required.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
items.description: Planner Agent chat is coming to Microsoft Planner basic plans starting September 2026, allowing users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses to interact with plans via AI-powered chat. It provides insights, task management, and plan creation using natural language and Microsoft 365 data, with admin controls for access.

items.title: (Updated) Outlook: Share Word, Excel and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
items.description: The new Outlook for Windows will support sending locally stored Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files as email attachments starting early November 2026 (worldwide) and mid-January 2027 (GCC). This feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and aligns with classic Outlook functionality.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports to manage metered consumption costs for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (preview)
items.description: A new Message consumption usage report for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing is now in preview, showing message usage by tenant, user, agent, and billing policy. It alerts when users exceed 2000 billed messages. General availability begins January 2027 with automatic rollout.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Entra: Improved restore experience for Authenticator passkeys on iOS
items.description: Microsoft Entra improves the iOS Microsoft Authenticator app's passkey restore experience with a clearer, guided flow for device migration, launching worldwide mid-September 2026. It affects iOS users with iCloud backup, requires no action, and includes updated user guidance without policy changes.

items.title: Unified management of app and agent availability and installation in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
items.description: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers in three phases from September 2025 to mid-September 2026. This ensures consistent policies, synchronized settings, and streamlined admin experience without immediate action required.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: New search experience for cloud files in the file attach picker
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable search for cloud files directly in the attach file picker starting June 2026, improving quick sharing by allowing users to find files faster without changing existing permissions. Rollout completes by September 2026, requiring no action but optional user communication and documentation updates.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced issue detection in Teams Rooms on Windows and auto-remediation with Teams Rooms Pro Management
items.description: Teams Rooms on Windows with Teams Rooms Pro will have enhanced issue detection and automatic remediation during nightly reboots, reducing downtime. Unresolved issues generate support tickets in the Pro Management portal. This feature is enabled by default starting mid-May 2026, with admins able to adjust settings as needed.

items.title: More control for Windows Autopatch updates: quality updates, .NET Framework, and quick machine recovery
(Updated) Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 dashboard for managers
items.description: The Agent 365 Dashboard for managers will roll out worldwide and in GCC from mid to late September 2026, extending team-level Microsoft Copilot Analytics access. Managers can view consolidated agent adoption and usage insights. Organizations should review VFAM settings to manage access and update relevant documentation.

items.title: (Updated) OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks' multimodal capture—combining audio transcription, image capture, and typed notes—is expanding to OneNote for Android. Available from mid-August 2026 (preview) and mid-September (general), it generates AI-structured pages saved in Copilot Notebooks, requiring Microsoft 365 Copilot and SharePoint/OneDrive licenses.

Dynamics 365 Commerce - Deploy and manage Dynamics 365 Commerce environments using Power Platform admin center
(Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updates to memory and personalization
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot updates Memory to personalize responses using chat history, with refreshed user controls for managing Saved Memory. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability begins mid-September 2026. Existing admin settings remain unchanged, and users can control personalization via updated settings.

Rollout occurs from mid-October to late November 2026. Admins should review policies, communicate changes, and update documentation accordingly.

items.description: A Copilot-powered conversational assistant embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience that answers configuration and how-to questions and provides step-by-step guidance. items.description: The Learning Cubed Update introduces cross-tenant multiplayer for dedicated servers and key features from the latest Bedrock updates.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
items.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Agent 365: the control plane for agents
items.description: Agent 365 is the control plane for AI agents. It empowers IT and security administrators to observe, govern, and secure agents across Microsoft 365 and connected platforms at scale.

items.description: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane to provide contextual insights and actionable suggestion chips based on email and destination content - such as highlighting key points, and recommending next actions - without disrupting the browsing flow. This experience helps users quickly understand content, take action with fewer steps, and get more value from Copilo…

items.description: Insider Risk Management is excited to announce the ability to preview content directly within an IRM alert without having to create a case. items.title: Universal Print: Logs and alerts
items.description: With a new Azure Monitor integration, Universal Print customers can send detailed diagnostic logs to a Log Analytics workspace to conduct troubleshooting and configure custom alerts.

items.title: External messaging limits for onmicrosoft.com-only organizations in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Microsoft Teams will impose outbound external messaging limits starting mid-September 2026 for organizations using only the default onmicrosoft.com domain to reduce spam and abuse. Limits may temporarily block external messages but won't affect internal communication. Admins should consider adding a custom domain and prepare support staff.

items.title: Organization skills support in Copilot for PowerPoint (Frontier release)
items.description: Microsoft will roll out organizational skills support for Copilot in PowerPoint (web, Windows, Mac) by early September 2026. Tenant admins can add and manage reusable, organization-specific skills via the Microsoft 365 admin center, enhancing user guidance without requiring pre-rollout action.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support summarization and contextual grounding
items.description: Microsoft Edge for Business now supports Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for summarization and contextual grounding across browser tabs, Microsoft 365 documents, and YouTube videos. The feature is off by default, respects DLP and policy settings, and requires Entra ID sign-in and appropriate licensing. Rollout begins mid-September 2026.

items.title: Microsoft Defender: Automated investigation and response (AIR) integrated into antivirus with manual triggering removed
items.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint will remove manual triggering and the standalone experience of automated investigation and response (AIR) by early September 2026. AIR functions are integrated into always-on antivirus protection. Organizations using AIR in playbooks or scripts must update them before September 1, 2026.

items.title: Create interactive slides in PowerPoint with Copilot skill (Windows and Mac)
items.description: PowerPoint's new "Create interactive slides" feature (Windows and Mac) enables users to easily create full-slide visuals for complex concepts, timelines, comparisons, systems, and data. Available now on Windows and rolling out on Mac by September 2026, it requires no pre-rollout action but recommends admin review and training updates.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
items.description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new GHCP harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

items.title: (Updated) Outlook for Windows report retirement in the Exchange admin center
items.description: The Outlook for Windows Usage Report in the Exchange admin center will retire from early to late November 2026. Admins must use the Microsoft 365 admin center for Outlook usage insights. No impact on Outlook functionality; no admin action required, but update any related documentation.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: Insert signature images from OneDrive
items.description: Starting late September to late October 2026, Outlook for iOS and Android will let users insert signature images from OneDrive as well as device photo libraries. This feature is enabled by default, requires no admin setup, and respects existing organizational data-sharing policies. No action is needed.

items.title: (Updated) Improved OneDrive experience in Apple Files app
items.description: OneDrive integration with Apple Files on iOS is improved for reliability and clearer upload status. Read-only shared and SharePoint library locations will no longer appear in Apple Files but remain accessible via the OneDrive app. Users can use "Add to OneDrive" to access and edit content in Apple Files. Rollout: mid-August to early November 2026. No admin action required.

items.title: Badges on profile cards in Teams
items.description: Microsoft Teams profile cards will display existing Awards and Certifications from Microsoft 365 profiles starting October 2026. This read-only feature shows titles, issuers, and details on badges if populated. No changes appear if these properties are empty. Review your organization's profile data accordingly.

items.title: Outlook: Offline settings "Days of email to save" admin policy
items.description: Tenant admins will be able to define the default value for "Days of email to save" in Offline settings and designate whether end users can change the setting. This policy will set and enforce the "Days of email to save" setting found under Settings > General > Offline. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Planner: Conditional Coloring
items.description: Conditional Coloring highlight tasks based on selected criteria, making priorities, status, and important task details easier to spot.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
items.description: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. Available in the Viva Engage app and Viva Engage in Teams mobile, the hub highlights top and sponsored campaigns, enables users to browse active and completed campaigns, and makes it easy to view campaign details and follow the campaigns that matter to them.
items.platforms: Android, iOS, Teams and Surface Devices

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Data Quality Report for Profile Data
items.description: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Services is introducing a new data quality report that helps administrators assess the coverage and health of people data used across Microsoft 365 experiences. High-quality people data enables users to more effectively discover and learn about colleagues through experiences such as the People Card, Org Explorer, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Cowork. The new report provid…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected.…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Proactive push notifications for the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
items.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will proactively send push notifications for common productivity workflows like 'Your Day at a Glance' and 'Items waiting for you', which send users to the respective Copilot response when opened. This feature taps into your Copilot Memory and will be available for users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses and can also be accessed once opening the Microsoft 365 Copilot app. Updat…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Now smarter with visuals: Copilot Chat leverages embedded images for richer, more accurate answers.
items.description: Copilot has been enhanced to interpret and ground responses using images embedded in files such as Word documents (.docx), PowerPoint presentations (.pptx), and PDFs. This capability allows Copilot to extract insights from visual elements like charts, diagrams, and screenshots, ensuring that answers are not only text-based but also informed by graphical context. By combining textual and visual understanding, Copilot…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected.…

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Adaptive Scopes for DLP for SharePoint
items.description: Adaptive Scope for SharePoint is a dynamic scoping capability in Microsoft Purview DLP that allows administrators to automatically target DLP policies to the right sites based on attributes such as site URL, site name, or custom site metadata. Unlike static scoping, which requires manually listing sites and maintaining them over time, adaptive scopes continuously evaluate site properties and auto‑include or exclude…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
items.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing. New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Outlook for iOS: Minimum system requirements updated to iOS 26 and above
items.description: Outlook for iOS will require iOS 26 or later starting mid-September 2026, supporting only the two latest iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS versions. Users on older versions may lose updates and syncing. Organizations should identify affected devices, notify users, and encourage OS upgrades. No admin changes needed.

items.title: Admin app retiring in Teams, Outlook and Microsoft365.com
items.product: Exchange Online, Microsoft 365 suite, Microsoft Teams
items.description: The Admin app for very small businesses in Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft365.com will retire by October 2026, with rollout starting August 2026. It will no longer be pre-installed or supported. Admins should use Microsoft Admin Center, Teams Admin Center, or Microsoft 365 Admin Agent instead.

items.title: Calls popout into a new window on the browser to support multi-tasking and collaboration during a meeting
items.description: Microsoft Teams for Web will introduce a Picture-in-Picture Call Monitor in October 2026, allowing users to manage meeting controls in a separate window while multitasking in other browser tabs. No admin action is needed; users must have supported browsers for this feature.

items.title: Microsoft Windows Autopatch: September 2026 Windows security update requires a restart for hotpatch-enabled devices
items.description: The September 2026 Windows security update requires a restart for hotpatch-enabled devices because it is a standard update. Devices will remain enrolled in hotpatching, with no changes to enrollment. Administrators should inform users, review restart policies, and monitor updates; no action or compliance changes are needed.

items.title: The September 2026 Windows security update requires a restart for hotpatch‑enabled devices
Allow connections to copilot.cloud.microsoft before the Copilot URL redirect
items.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. Organizations must ensure network and security controls allow access to copilot.cloud.microsoft to avoid service disruption. Review and update firewall, proxy, and allow lists to permit *.cloud.microsoft traffic before October 2026.

items.title: Microsoft Agent 365: Active Users export for agent usage reporting
items.description: Microsoft Agent 365 will add an Active Users export in the Microsoft 365 admin center, allowing AI and Global Admins to generate a CSV report of users who used agents in the past 30 days. This read-only feature aids licensing reviews and requires no preparation.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: AI meeting archive file generation
items.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting archive files starting October 2026 to enhance Copilot and Facilitator responses. Archives store AI-generated insights (not raw content) in tenant-owned SharePoint, with admin controls for enabling, retention, and compliance. Users cannot access archives directly; data privacy and access are strictly managed.

items.title: Prepare for the removal of WMIC from Windows 11
The August 2026 Windows non-security preview update is now available
(Updated) Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: Microsoft Teams is adding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Windows for in-person meetings. Rolling out worldwide from late October to mid-November 2026, it enables real-time note-taking stored securely in tenant-owned SharePoint. Licensing and configuration prerequisites apply; no extra admin enablement needed.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Android, enabling real-time notes during in-person meetings. Notes are securely stored in tenant-owned SharePoint, accessible via meeting recap in Teams desktop. Rollout begins late October 2026, requiring Teams Rooms Pro licensing and specific tenant settings.

items.title: (Updated) Collaborate with Copilot in Outlook while drafting email
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will enable a new side-by-side email drafting experience in Outlook starting early March 2026, allowing licensed users to collaborate with Copilot in real time. The feature rolls out across Outlook platforms through late 2026, is enabled by default, and requires no admin changes or user action.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
items.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer Name in Calendar View on Teams Panels and MTR-A.
items.description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the calendar view on Teams panels and MTR-Android. In Pro Management Portal, admins can toggle the "Show Organizer Name" setting ON or OFF. On the panel device, admins can toggle the "Show organizer names" setting ON or OFF. On the MTRA console device and All In One Display device, admins can toggle the "Show organizer names on calendar" setting ON or…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
items.description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

items.title: Planner: Track task progress with the Completion (%) field
items.description: The new Completion (%) column in Microsoft Planner provides a more precise view of task progress. Users can view and update completion as a percentage, helping teams communicate incremental progress and quickly understand how far work has advanced.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
items.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

items.title: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
items.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
items.description: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractio…
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: SharePoint: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
items.description: Users will be able access an AI generated audio summary of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams (Viva Connections).

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
items.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
items.description: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
items.description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

items.title: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
items.description: Users will now have basic options for printing calendar events in #newoutlookforwindows and Teams calendar, including choosing whether to show all attendees or display a shortened list of up to 10 attendees via a checkbox.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager-Purview Compliance Manager integration with Microsoft Foundry for automated mapping of AI regulations and evaluation of Compliance controls for Foundry Agents
items.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to automatically access the compliance posture of Agents created in AI Foundry. Customers can map Agents being created in AI Foundry to compliance regulations and assessments in Purview Compliance Manager and get to know the compliance status and improvement actions to be innovative and compliant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates
items.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to convert complex regulations from PDF documents to actionable controls and actions in multi cloud environment. Customers can use the converted regulatory templates to create assessments and identify compliance gaps, understand and implement controls to improve their compliance posture.

items.title: Viva Glint - Action Taking Report (Public Preview)
items.description: Introduction of a new report that provides transparency into platform activity by dashboard users. Metrics such as report views, Team Conversations completed, and Focus Areas created will be visible and filterable with this report.

At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
items.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes for presenters starting September 2026. This update enhances flexibility, accessibility, and personalization without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action is needed.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Draft Outlook emails directly in Copilot Chat on mobile
items.product: Exchange Online, Microsoft 365 apps, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat on mobile will embed an Outlook email draft experience, allowing users to draft, review, and open emails in Outlook Mobile seamlessly. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide from mid-August to mid-September 2026 with no admin action required.

items.title: Microsoft SharePoint : Dashboard Card Visibility on Mobile
items.description: Dashboard authors can now control the visibility of individual SharePoint dashboard cards on mobile devices, enhancing mobile user experience. This feature will roll out globally from late August to early September 2026. No action is required, but authors are encouraged to optimize dashboards for mobile users.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
items.description: Microsoft Teams will improve highlighted text visibility in dark and high contrast modes for a more consistent, accessible editing experience. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by early October 2026. This is a visual enhancement only; no user action is required.

items.title: Microsoft Teams and Google Calendar sync retirement
items.description: Microsoft is retiring calendar syncing between Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace in October 2026, ending support for this feature. Organizations should notify users, save account matching data, and use the Microsoft Teams Meeting add-on for Google Workspace for meeting scheduling instead.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: App Governance support for the Cloud Application Administrator role is being retired
items.description: Support for the Cloud Application Administrator role in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps' App Governance will retire on September 26, 2026. Organizations must reassign affected administrators to supported roles like Security Administrator to maintain access when URBAC is enabled. Review role assignments by September 25, 2026.

items.title: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring
items.description: Microsoft Teams admin center will launch a single pane for monitoring and troubleshooting meetings and calls organization-wide, available from late September to mid-October 2026. Admins can view in-progress and completed meetings, identify issues, use detailed diagnostics, apply filters, export data, and leverage Microsoft 365 Copilot for analysis.

items.title: Ask Copilot in Teams
items.description: Ask Copilot in Microsoft Teams lets users quickly get Copilot help from specific messages or selected text without copying content. Rolling out globally from late August to September 2026, it’s available on desktop, web, and mobile. No admin action is needed; existing licensing and controls apply.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Domain update for My Account and identity self-service experiences
items.description: Microsoft Entra is updating its self-service identity management domain from myaccount.microsoft.com to myaccount.cloud.microsoft, consolidating related sites for a unified experience. The change rolls out worldwide in late November 2026. Users need no action; administrators should ensure *.cloud.microsoft domains are allowed in network policies.

items.title: Migrate Copilot Studio agents to Microsoft Entra Agent ID
(Updated) Viva Engage: Email updates for frontline users without an active Exchange mailbox
items.description: Starting mid-September 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to users without valid mailboxes, reducing email system load and improving delivery. Users with supported mailboxes will be unaffected. Notifications via Teams remain unchanged. No action is required, but admins should review mailbox configurations and update support documentation.

items.title: Simplified access to Copilot Chat on the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
items.description: Access to Copilot Chat on the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will be simplified by removing restrictions from the Intune policy and "Analyze content" privacy control. This change, rolling out August to September 2026, requires no admin action but may affect organizational controls and documentation.

items.title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel

items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will add AI-generated intelligent summaries by late September 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. The feature is on by default, requires no configuration, and includes suggested prompts. No user impact or compliance issues are expected.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification settings
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with customizable options for mentions and threads. Rollout begins October 2026 across platforms and environments, enabled by default with no admin changes needed. No user action required; inform helpdesk and update documentation.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Facilitator feature with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) that detects knowledge gaps in meetings, performs web searches, and posts relevant answers in the chat to improve productivity. It requires manual enabling, supports standard meetings, and includes admin controls for configuration.

items.title: 2 weeks until Teams device management begins transitioning from Teams admin center to Teams Rooms Pro management portal
items.description: Starting September 1, 2026, Teams device management will transition from Teams admin center to Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, completing by end of September. Admins must migrate Teams Android devices to PMP to avoid management disruptions, updating agents and verifying device visibility before the deadline.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android will support attendee proximity join for Teams events, enabling faster connection to nearby room systems. Rollout starts October 2026, completing by mid-November. The feature activates automatically, requiring no action, and improves joining town halls, webinars, and meetings.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings, enhancing security. The rollout starts mid-September 2026, with default off. Admins can enable and assign this policy; no changes occur unless activated. Recommendations include piloting and communication.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: In‑meeting toggle to turn Meeting AI on or off
items.description: Microsoft Teams will add a toggle for licensed organizers and presenters to turn Meeting AI (Copilot and Facilitator) on or off during meetings, starting mid-September 2026. Turning off AI disables recording and transcription. The feature respects existing policies, requires no action, and aims to enhance control over AI use in meetings.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable the Investment project feature
Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management - Protect confirmed CTP dates with Planning Optimization
Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

items.title: Planner: Connected Plans
items.description: Connected Plans let teams link related plans together to organize work across projects and initiatives. Navigate between connected plans and make related work easier to find and manage.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
items.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

items.title: Outlook: Drag and Drop
items.description: You can now reschedule events by dragging them to a new time slot in your calendar. This feature is available in day and multi day views.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Open message links in new window
items.description: Teams now enables links within chat and channel messages to open in a new window, so you can compare information side by side without losing the context of your ongoing conversation. Access this capability through the More options menu or by using Ctrl/Cmd + click.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
items.description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle…

items.title: Outlook: 1-year and 2-year options for email sync window (Offline settings)
items.description: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access. This expands the existing offline settings and allows users to access more email when they are not connected to the internet. The new options are available under Settings > General > Offline > Days of email to save, giving users greater flexibility based on their storage and offline needs."

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Newly created Declarative Agents now understand referenced scanned PDFs
items.description: Any newly created Declarative Agents can now reliably ground answers in scanned PDFs and image-based documents referenced from SharePoint, unlocking a major class of enterprise content that was previously hard to use in agent scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Tip Support in Outlook for Mac
items.description: DLP policy tips for Microsoft Outlook for Mac provide real-time notifications to users when their email contains sensitive information that violates organizational policies. Users can see policy tips directly in the mail tip UI and have the option to remove non-compliant recipients or override the policy if necessary. This feature ensures compliance by alerting users to potential data loss risks before sending email…

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: DLP Policy Tip Support in Outlook Mobile
items.description: DLP policy tip support for Outlook Mobile enhances data loss prevention measures on mobile devices by providing real-time alerts to help users avoid accidentally sharing sensitive information, ensuring compliance with organizational policies.

items.title: Microsoft Defender XDR: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
items.description: Microsoft Defender XDR is enhancing the Identity page's Timeline tab to provide a unified, chronological view of identity-related activities and alerts from multiple Microsoft security sources. Rolling out mid-September to mid-October 2026, it offers improved context, filtering, and automatic updates without changing existing policies. No action is required to enable it.

items.title: Microsoft Defender XDR: Unified response actions across identity accounts
items.description: Microsoft Defender XDR unifies identity response actions across linked accounts, enabling security teams to manage actions like disabling accounts or forcing password changes from one workflow. It supports multiple identity systems and SaaS apps, enhancing response speed and consistency. Rollout begins mid-October 2026 worldwide.

items.title: Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces Session and Response Sharing, allowing users to share chat sessions or individual responses via links within their organization. Shared content is read-only, with recipients able to continue conversations. The feature rolls out late August 2026, is enabled by default, and can be disabled tenant-wide by admins.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot: Effort control for models in Cowork
items.description: Microsoft Copilot Cowork now lets users select effort levels (Light, Medium, High) in the model picker to control response quality, speed, and usage. This feature, rolling out globally by late August 2026, requires no admin action but may need user guidance on effort selection.

items.title: Copilot Studio - Billing for GitHub Copilot harness built agents begins September 1, 2026
(Updated) Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation

Migration to Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy begins September 2026, with rollout completing by October 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid service disruption. Hybrid/on-premises scenarios are excluded.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Multilingual meeting recaps support personalized recap translation
items.description: Microsoft Teams will personalize meeting recaps by displaying them initially in each participant's selected translation or interpretation language, with options to change languages afterward. This enhances multilingual collaboration and accessibility, rolling out globally from early August to early September 2026, requiring no admin action.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: External presenters can manage event production controls
items.description: Microsoft Teams will allow trusted external presenters (federated B2B and guest users) to manage event production controls starting early August 2026. Organizers can assign these permissions via the "Who has control of production tools" setting, enabling external partners to manage attendee experiences during Teams events.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams: Bilingual consecutive interpretation mode with Interpreter agent
items.description: Microsoft paused the rollout of the new bilingual consecutive interpretation mode in Microsoft Teams with the Interpreter agent. This mode enables structured, turn-by-turn multilingual meetings for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users. No tenant configuration is needed, and existing policies remain unchanged. Updates will be provided when rollout resumes.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Whiteboard: Retirement of legacy whiteboards and transition to OneDrive-backed whiteboards
items.description: Microsoft Whiteboard is retiring legacy whiteboards and the standalone app. Migration to OneDrive-backed whiteboards must be completed by September 25, 2026. Legacy whiteboards will be deleted October 16, 2026, and the standalone app deprecated November 30, 2026. Users must migrate or export content before these dates.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Roadmap is becoming the AI at Work Roadmap
items.description: On August 25, 2026, Microsoft 365 Roadmap will be renamed AI at Work Roadmap, expanding to include Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse updates from September 2026. It centralizes AI-powered innovation tracking without changing access or workflows; no immediate action is required.

items.title: Action required: Allow new Windows App client-side endpoints for Windows 365
items.description: Starting early October 2026, Windows App will use three new wildcard domains for Windows 365 client traffic. Organizations with network controls must allow outbound HTTPS on port 443 to these domains to avoid connection issues. Review and update firewall, proxy, VPN, DNS, and Secure Web Gateway settings accordingly.

items.title: Power Platform admin center - Cost controls - Draw from tenant credit pool
Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
items.description: Microsoft Teams will allow adding Facilitator to channel meetings to take notes, manage agendas, answer questions, and handle tasks. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by mid-October 2026. No action or compliance changes are required for organizations with Facilitator enabled.

items.title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: room users can change the app language
items.description: Teams Rooms on Android will allow users to temporarily change the app language per session from the console, aligning with Windows experience. This feature rolls out from June to October 2026 with app version 2.12.0+, resets after restart, requires no admin action, and does not affect system settings.

items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
items.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over…

items.title: Outlook: Manage Multiple Inbox Rules at Once
items.description: You will soon be able to manage multiple inbox rules at the same time. Select every rule or choose only the ones you want to update. You can then delete, enable, or disable the selected rules in one action. This makes it faster and easier to keep your rules organized. #newoutlookforwindows

Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. items.title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook mobile apps
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on mobile devices.
