items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): People Skills- removal and deletion admin control
items.description: A new admin control in the People Skills settings lets administrators permanently remove their organization's People Skills data from the tenant. With this new control, organizations can delete their entire skills library along with all users confirmed, inferred, and imported skills data—giving them full control to offboard from People Skills in support of data governance and compliance needs. Once deletion is initi…

items.title: Universal Print: Universal Print Portal
items.description: You can release your secure print jobs by scanning a QR code at any printer and access your print workflows from a browser on any device, all signed in with your Microsoft 365 account.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced bookable desk experience with Teams panel-based desk dock devices
items.description: Users have better experiences in flexible work environments with Microsoft Teams panel-based desk dock devices coming later this year. The Teams panel app now enables devices, such as the Yealink Linkhub, to enhance bookable desk experiences by indicating at-a-glance availability and letting visitors book directly on the device. Each device requires a Teams Shared Space license.

items.title: Planner: Microsoft Planner tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
items.description: Digital signage can now be displayed on idle Teams panel devices, similar to digital signage support for Microsoft Teams Rooms front of room displays. Signage source and settings can be configured in the Pro Management portal. Available with Teams Rooms Pro or Shared space-licensed spaces.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
items.description: Speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by launching Data Security Investigations (DSI) from endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alerts. In DSI, define your endpoint DLP query (for example, time range, users, and endpoints). DSI then automatically gathers the related files that triggered the alerts for review (for example, UserA downloaded a file on 3/1/2026).

items.title: Planner: Custom Templates
items.description: Custom templates let you create reusable, pre-designed layouts tailored to your organization’s needs, ensuring consistency and saving time. They provide flexibility to standardize content while allowing easy customization for specific scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices
items.description: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices.

items.title: (Updated) OneDrive macOS Native Sync Engine
items.description: Microsoft is introducing a new Native Sync Engine for OneDrive on macOS, improving sync speed, reliability, and resource efficiency. Rollout begins September 2026, completing by November. No admin action is required, but admins should notify users about Finder sidebar changes and update documentation accordingly.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
items.description: Microsoft Purview’s Data Security Investigations will add endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) events as a queryable source, enabling admins to analyze related files automatically. Rollout occurs June to September 2026, enhancing investigation efficiency without user impact or required admin action.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in call recap in the Queues app
items.description: Microsoft Teams is adding Copilot in call recap within the Queues app for recorded call queue calls, enabling users with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams Premium licenses to get summaries and ask questions about calls. Rollout starts early September 2026 with no admin action required.

items.title: Prepare for upcoming changes to the Excel Exchange connector
items.description: New Exchange Mail and Calendar connectors for Excel Power Query will replace the current Microsoft Exchange connector by April 2027. Workbook owners must manually migrate connections and upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office 2024. Admins should prepare users and workbooks for this transition starting now.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
items.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will soon support multiple sequential actions in a single workflow, enabling richer automations to reduce manual tasks, consolidate processes, and improve productivity. The feature rolls out worldwide in early to mid-September 2026, requiring no admin action but user awareness updates.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Exchange Online: Prepare for Exchange Web Services retirement with EWSAllowedAppIDs
items.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online will retire starting October 1, 2026, with full retirement by April 1, 2027. Microsoft introduced EWSAllowedAppIDs, allowing admins to create an allow list of approved apps to use EWS, helping manage access and prevent disruptions during retirement enforcement.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updated service plan behavior for Copilot experiences
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot service plan now controls Premium or Basic grounding for licensed users, simplifying admin management. Rollout starts end of August 2026, completing by September. Personal Content Mode disables with the plan off. No licensing changes; review assignments and update documentation accordingly.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Entra: System-preferred authentication now applies to first-factor authentication
items.description: Microsoft Entra now applies system-preferred authentication to first-factor sign-ins for tenants in the Microsoft managed state, selecting the most secure registered method. Rollout is from late June to late September 2026. Tenants can keep or change this setting and should update user guidance accordingly.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal agent available in Frontier worldwide
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Legal agent in Word is now in Public Preview worldwide for Frontier users, expanding from the US. It helps legal professionals review contracts, identify risks, compare clauses, and generate edits using AI. Available mid-June 2026, with general availability in October 2026.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot app update: Simpler Copilot access
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app is updating to a unified app for personal and work accounts with clearer visual cues, a simpler name and icon, and a new web URL (copilot.cloud.microsoft). Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to security, compliance, or enterprise controls.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Personalized Copilot Suggestions Coming to Frontier
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will introduce personalized AI suggestions in Copilot Chat for eligible Frontier program users starting early August 2026. These contextual prompts help users discover AI use cases based on their work patterns. No admin action is needed; users can choose to engage with suggestions.

items.title: New in Microsoft 365 Copilot: Self-serve Copilot Connectors
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot now offers self-serve connectors, allowing users to securely sync external data like Jira and Confluence with their credentials. Administrators control connector availability and rollout. This feature enhances information discovery in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search, with a worldwide rollout from August to October 2026.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Local Pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will add native local Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera controls for compatible mechanical or optical PTZ cameras, allowing users to adjust cameras directly from the room console during meetings. Rollout starts September 2026, requires no action, and support for digital PTZ will come later.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports migrating to new domains
items.description: Microsoft 365 admin center Usage reports domains will change starting mid-August 2026, with current and new domains active in parallel for at least 30 days. Organizations must update firewall, proxy, and scripts to include new domains to avoid access issues. Redirects and domain retirements will be announced later.

items.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
items.description: Microsoft Entra ID will support passkey registration and sign-in for B2B users to meet resource tenant MFA requirements, enhancing phishing resistance. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out from October 2026 to February 2027, requiring no admin action but recommending policy reviews to align user scopes and MFA settings.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Retirement of Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG)
items.description: Microsoft Edge will retire support for Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG) by late September 2026. Organizations using these on Windows 10 must migrate to Microsoft Purview solutions and Edge's built-in security features, as these capabilities are already removed in Windows 11 version 24H2.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Prepare custom apps for private and shared channel compatibility
items.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a feature by September 2026 to help admins identify custom line-of-business apps needing updates for private and shared channel compatibility. Updating these apps ensures business continuity, reduces support issues, and maintains app access across evolving channel experiences.

items.title: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
items.description: Copilot in OneDrive Web enables users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to find, understand, analyze, create, and act on files using natural language without opening each file. It respects existing permissions and governance, rolling out from August 2026 as an opt-out preview with unified controls for OneDrive and SharePoint.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning retirement of Microsoft 365 training content
items.description: Microsoft is retiring 161 Microsoft 365 training modules and selected articles from Viva Learning on September 21, 2026, removing outdated content. Learning administrators should update learning paths, notify users, and encourage completion of in-progress training before retirement. Replacement content will be provided where available.

items.title: Plan for Change: Windows settings backup policy is becoming a new default
items.description: Starting with Windows 11 version 26H2 (second half of 2026), the Windows settings backup policy will default to enabled on eligible devices unless explicitly configured otherwise. Restore remains admin-controlled and off by default. Organizations should review and configure backup and restore policies as needed before deployment.

items.title: Planner: Capacity view
items.description: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
items.description: Configure retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory to help preserve historical versions of memory items for security, compliance, and investigation scenarios. Copilot memory includes saved memories and details inferred from chat history that enable more personalized and context-aware Copilot experiences. Copilot memory items are stored in a hidden folder in the user’s Exchange mailbox. This capability will enable…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Coordinated meetings support on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Teams Rooms on Android now supports coordinated meetings, enabling paired Teams Rooms on Android devices and Android-based touch boards to work together in the same hybrid meeting experience. This feature enables coordinated join and leave, and collaboration across front-of-room displays and touch boards. This creates more immersive and flexible meeting spaces for both in-room and remote participants.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 admin center – New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report for GCC High & DoD
items.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report will include total enabled and active users, Copilot usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Sign in to Edge with a Google account
items.description: Users can now sign in to Microsoft Edge using a Google account in addition to the Microsoft account from the profile menu and Edge sign-in screen. Available for Windows and macOS devices. Admins can control availability to this feature using the NonMicrosoftAccountSignInEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
items.description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

items.description: Introduces a new REST endpoint for Work IQ that serves as a unified entry point for invoking agents and workflows, providing a consistent, scalable alternative to legacy Copilot Chat endpoints.

items.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Introducing Microsoft Scout, an always-on personal agent
items.description: Microsoft Scout is an always-on personal Autopilot agent integrated across Microsoft 365 apps, acting autonomously within organizational policies. Available now in Frontier preview on Windows and macOS, it requires admin enablement, Intune policy configuration, and GitHub Copilot licensing. It respects security and compliance guardrails.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized default mark and notify email template
items.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will localize the default "Mark and notify" email template based on users' Outlook language settings, improving clarity in user-reported message notifications. Rollout starts June 2026 worldwide, completing by September 2026. No action is required; admins may inform users and review settings.

items.title: Preparing the Windows ecosystem for next-generation code signing
Filter Messages by Events
items.description: Outlook will add an "Events" filter to help users quickly find calendar invitations and event-related messages. Rolling out globally from late August to September 2026, it requires no admin action but suggests updating user communications and support materials.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
items.description: Administrators can set severity thresholds to receive alerts for Microsoft Edge updates with significant security fixes, including zero-day patches. This feature, rolling out worldwide in August 2026, requires no admin action and helps prioritize important updates while reducing routine notifications.

items.title: SharePoint Page and News Post: Content Update flow in the FAQ web part will be retired
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part's Content Update flow, which provided AI-generated answer suggestions, will be retired worldwide by late September 2026. Authors must manually edit FAQs going forward. Existing content remains unaffected, no admin action is needed, but authors should be informed and training updated accordingly.

items.title: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
items.description: Users with eligible Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses can access AI-generated audio summaries of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams starting mid-August 2026. No action is needed, and administrators can manage access via licensing controls. The feature complies with data residency and processing commitments.

items.title: Microsoft Outlook: Classic Outlook theme experience for Outlook on the web and Outlook for Windows
items.description: Microsoft is introducing an optional setting in Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows to mimic classic Outlook’s look and feel. It helps users transitioning from classic Outlook by adjusting visual style and layout. The setting is off by default, can be toggled anytime, and rolls out globally from August to October 2026. No admin action is required.

items.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Retirement of custom CSS layout and positioning properties in company branding
items.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire custom CSS layout and positioning properties in company branding by late October 2026 to enhance security and reduce phishing risks. Organizations using these properties must update branding configurations before then; new use will be blocked from July 21, 2026. Branding will revert to default layouts after retirement.

items.title: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Microsoft Teams' Copilot experience will be simplified with a chat-centered design, improved navigation, updated chat layout, Work IQ controls, and a new Tasks view in full-screen mode. The update, available September 2026, requires no user action but administrators should update training and support materials accordingly.

items.title: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Outlook
items.description: Microsoft Outlook's Copilot experience will be refreshed by September 2026 with a simplified, chat-centered design in both full-page and side pane views. Enhancements include improved navigation, chat layout, agent interaction, and Work IQ controls. No user or admin action is needed; administrators should update related documentation and inform users.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Teams Events Attendance and Engagement Report Policy
items.description: Microsoft Teams now separates attendance and engagement report controls for Teams Events from Teams Meetings via a new CsTeamsEventsPolicy. Rollout begins mid-October 2026. Administrators can independently configure report access with four policy options. Review and update policies and documentation accordingly after rollout.

Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – Enhanced multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options
items.description: Viva Glint administrators will be able to create multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options and upload options using a CSV file. For questions containing more than 50 options, survey takers can search and filter the available responses, making longer lists faster and easier to navigate. Reporting will support the expanded option set.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – In-product access to feature announcements
items.description: Viva Glint service administrators will see a new announcement icon in the product header that links directly to the Viva Glint Tech Community blog. This makes it easier to discover product news, feature announcements, and best practices.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
items.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, i…

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Import Google account data anytime from Settings
items.description: Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrom…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage. Users can hide the room self-preview video and choose to see audio and video participants equally on stage, instead of prioritizing video participants. Admins can choose the default behavior using local device settings and…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New controls for quick views in the chat list
items.description: The new chats and channels experience introduced quick views at the top of the chat and channels list. These are views into mentions, followed threads and more. This update allows users to choose when and how these quick views are shown. Users will have options such as always show, always hide and show only when unread. Users will also be able to collapse the quick views section.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame people labels in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants and provide a hover-over contact card using voice and face profiles on intelligent cameras and in the cloud. Available with Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 356 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
items.description: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: The Interpreter agent acts as a translator in Microsoft Teams meetings, allowing participants to listen to the meeting in their chosen language with real-time translation so speaking different languages isn’t a barrier to effective understanding and collaboration. It's now available in Teams Rooms on Android licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Recent feed in Viva Engage
items.description: Introducing a new “Recent” feed in Home to give users a more predictable view of followed and priority communications, while preserving the existing personalized “For you” experience.

items.title: Built‑in AI Interpreter for Calls on Teams Phone Devices
items.description: With AI Interpreter, Teams Phone Devices provide real‑time language interpretation directly within the call experience. Users can participate naturally in multilingual conversations while the device interprets spoken audio, reducing language barriers and supporting clearer communication in everyday calling scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
items.description: Use the new PAYGO consumption-based meter to pay for your extra SharePoint storage needs. This reduces the operational overhead associated with purchasing extra storage packs and more seamlessly integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Channel agent orchestration with GitHub, Asana, and Jira via Model Context Protocol (MCP)
items.description: Microsoft Teams' Channel Agent integration with GitHub, Asana, and Jira via Model Context Protocol (MCP) rollout is paused. This feature enables task orchestration across tools within Teams, requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and will be previewed with admin enablement when resumed.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels by mid-October 2026, automatically identifying enrolled in-room participants with name labels and contact cards for remote attendees. This feature enhances hybrid meetings, requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, supports voice and face recognition enrollment, and can be managed via Teams meeting policies.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: AI-powered live interpretation on Teams Phone devices
items.description: AI-powered live interpretation will roll out on certified Microsoft Teams Phone devices worldwide from mid-October to late October 2026 for users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. It supports real-time language interpretation in various call types, requires policy enabling, and is off by default.

items.title: (Updated) Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
items.description: Microsoft 365 will change the default visibility of 11 profile card properties to display by default when populated, starting late September 2026. Administrators can review and hide specific properties using Microsoft Graph APIs before rollout. Visibility remains manageable post-rollout via the admin center.

items.title: (Updated) OneDrive for the web: Document library views now available in OneDrive
items.description: OneDrive for the web now lets users access, switch, create, and manage SharePoint document library views directly within OneDrive, enhancing productivity without changing data or permissions. The feature rolls out worldwide from mid-July to late August 2026 and is enabled by default. No action is required.

items.title: New PowerShell scripts to manage Windows settings backup data
(Updated) Power BI integration with Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Starting mid-June 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot will answer questions using Power BI data for Frontier-enrolled organizations, respecting existing permissions. The feature is enabled by default, with admin controls available. Rollout spans Frontier and worldwide through early September 2026, requiring Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium and Power BI licenses.

items.title: (Updated) Copilot Chat can float over your Outlook iPad and Mac window
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac and iPad can now be popped out into a floating, resizable window for easier multitasking. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from late August to mid-September 2026. No action is required, but user notification is recommended.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Code Blocks in M365 Copilot
items.description: M365 Copilot now supports code blocks, which lets you preview code, charts, diagrams, and more directly inline while using Chat. Previously, users could preview code side-by-side in a code canvas.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Improvements to agent evaluations experience
items.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio is enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior. New capabilities include richer evaluation explanations, agent reasoning traces, cited knowledge sources, evaluation run comparison, support for larger datasets, customizable test generation, and dataset generation from knowledge sources. These improvements help makers identify quality issues…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investi…

items.title: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
items.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Emoji shortcuts with autocomplete on mobile
items.description: Teams brings desktop-style emoji shortcuts to mobile (iOS and Android), allowing you to insert emojis by typing colon-based commands like :smile:. Real-time autocomplete suggestions help you quickly find the right emoji as you type, while support for custom emojis enables more personalized and expressive communication on the go.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved visibility and control for downloads
items.description: Download manager updates in Microsoft Teams make it easier to track file progress with improved visibility, control, and accessibility. items.description: Microsoft Defender for Identity now includes a health alert for missing domain controller network traffic, helping administrators detect traffic collection issues affecting visibility. The alert appears in sensor health tabs, requires no pre-rollout action, and guides troubleshooting if triggered after rollout. No impact on end users or compliance.

items.title: New Defender for Identity health issue for missing Windows events from a domain controller
items.description: Microsoft Defender for Identity now includes a new sensor health issue, "No Windows events received from domain controller," to alert administrators of missing Windows events. This improves visibility into event collection gaps affecting detections. It is available now, requires no pre-rollout action, and helps identify domain controller issues.

items.title: Copilot in Excel - Power BI Grounding
items.description: Microsoft Copilot in Excel now integrates with Power BI reports, allowing users to query governed, permission-controlled data directly in Excel without extra licenses. This streamlines analysis by combining Excel flexibility with trusted Power BI metrics, respecting existing security controls like row-level security. No admin action needed.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
items.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. items.title: (Updated) Introducing the new SharePoint experience

items.title: Updates to Tenant External Recipient Rate Limit (TERRL) Quotas for New, Trial, and Education Tenants

Trial tenant quotas reduce to 500 recipients daily; EDU quotas use a new formula. Exceeding limits blocks outbound messages.

items.title: Campaigns in SharePoint

Rolling out worldwide from July to September 2026, it requires no admin action, supports Viva Amplify users, and maintains existing Viva Amplify campaign functions.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updates to Copilot Tuning and transition to Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot tuning via Agent Builder templates will pause to transition to Microsoft Copilot Studio, introducing a skill-based architecture. Existing agents remain functional; tuning stops by August 20, 2026. Public preview starts September 2026, general availability in December 2026. No automatic migration; admins should complete tuning beforehand.

items.title: Retirement Notice of Learning Coach Agent in M365 Copilot
items.description: The Learning Coach Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot will retire in early October 2026, becoming inaccessible afterward. Users should transition to the Learning Agent before then. items.title: Retiring Teams Shifts Connection cmdlets from Teams PowerShell Module
items.description: Microsoft is retiring Teams Shifts Connection cmdlets in Microsoft Teams PowerShell Module 7.9.0. Organizations using these cmdlets must update or remove dependencies before upgrading, as scripts relying on them will stop working. Those not using these cmdlets are unaffected.

items.description: Starting mid-April 2026, admins can manage Microsoft 365 certified third-party Teams apps via org-wide settings in the Teams admin center, enabling rule-based app availability control. The rollout is automatic, with the new control disabled by default. No tenant-wide changes occur without admin action.

items.title: (Updated) Co-organizer experience updates in Teams Webinars and Townhalls
items.description: Co-organizers in Teams Webinars and Townhalls can now fully manage events, including editing details, publishing, and canceling, achieving parity with organizers. Rollout starts mid-January 2025 for targeted release and mid-June 2026 for general availability, with no preparation needed.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in Teams meetings
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a meeting" feature starting August 2026, allowing users to report suspicious or malicious activity during meetings. Reports help security teams investigate threats via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center. The feature is enabled by default, with administrative controls and data collection for security investigations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Users can report security concerns in group calls
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a call" feature for group calls, allowing users to report suspicious calls from call history. Administrators can review reports in Teams admin center and Microsoft Defender. The feature rolls out from August to October 2026 and is enabled by default.

items.title: (Updated) Cowork in Frontier: New Value + Usage-based Billing
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork moves to general availability June 16, 2026, with usage-based billing required by July 1. Mobile rollout is delayed in some regions until August. Frontier users get early access to new features and GPT 5.5. Admins must configure billing by June 30 to avoid service disruption.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Scheduled Prompts moves to Microsoft 365 Connected Experiences
items.description: Scheduled Prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot will move from the Optional Connected Experiences policy to Microsoft 365 Connected Experiences by late August 2026. This change affects governance and compliance controls but not user functionality. Administrators should review and update policies accordingly; most organizations need no action.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced live captions settings and right-side panel view
items.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing live captions with a new right-side panel view and a consolidated settings menu for easier configuration. Users can auto-enable captions, submit feedback, and benefit from synchronized translation settings. Rollout begins mid-August 2026 with no admin action required.

items.title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Custom branding for tenant-wide visual identity
items.description: Microsoft Viva Engage introduces Custom Branding, allowing admins to apply tenant-wide brand name, logos, and theme color via a Brand Center. This overrides individual user themes and Microsoft 365 org themes within Viva Engage. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with preview and publishing controls for admins.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Unified management experience for connectors in the Microsoft 365 admin center
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot connector management will be unified in the Microsoft 365 admin center (Copilot > Connectors) starting early August 2026. This simplifies administration and discovery without changing governance, security, or compliance controls. No action is required before rollout; administrators should update documentation and inform teams.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
items.description: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Additional health signals available for Teams Rooms on Android on Pro Management Portal
items.description: Expanded Pro Management Portal (PMP) health monitoring for Teams Rooms on Android by surfacing device health signals including storage health, Teams meeting app, calendar sync, secondary display health and network. When issues are detected, PMP will automatically generate actionable alerts and support ticket creation workflows, enabling IT administrators to proactively identify and triage room health issues before t…

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage: New left navigation controls — collapse, resize, increased favorites cap, and reorder favorites capabilities
items.description: We're introducing a set of left-navigation improvements in Viva Engage on the web that give people more control over their navigation pane. These are additive, user-driven changes — users can collapse the left nav, resize its width, favorite up to 50 communities, and drag to reorder their favorited communities. None of these changes alter which destinations appear in the navigation. These enhancements are applicable…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot memory in Researcher
items.description: Copilot memory within Researcher brings forward relevant context from your past interactions—helping ground insights, personalize outputs, and reduce repetitive setup as you explore complex topics.

items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.
items.platforms: Desktop, Mac, Teams and Surface Devices, Web

items.title: Outlook: Insert Signature Image from OneDrive
items.description: Users can now insert images into their email signature directly from OneDrive, in addition to the device photo library.

items.title: Outlook: Filter Messages by Events
items.description: You can now filter your messages for calendar invitations. Simply go to the filter and select Events from the drop down.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
items.description: Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. Admins configure the feature per queue via Teams admin center or PowerShell, with controls for recording, transcription and agent access to recordings. Recordings are stored in SharePoint and available through the Queues app c…

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Allow M365 authentication popups in work profiles
items.description: When users are signed in with a work account, some Microsoft 365 sites (for example, microsoft.com, cloud.microsoft, and microsoft365.com) may open authentication pop-up windows to Microsoft sign-in endpoints such as login.microsoftonline.com, login.live.com, or login.microsoft.com. These pop-ups are required to complete sign-in. Microsoft Edge now allows authentication pop-up windows from Microsoft first party serv…

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.151 - Passkey Sync for Enterprise Users
items.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing support for passkey synchronization for enterprise users, enabling secure, passwordless authentication across devices. Passkeys created in Edge can now be synced seamlessly, improving sign-in experience while maintaining strong security standards.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
items.description: A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. This includes updates to the chat home screen, chat response layout, and navigation pane.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
items.description: We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false. For Microsoft 365 E5 customers, the experience also includes…

items.title: Outlook: Copilot now provides concise summaries with Outlook search results
items.description: Get answers to queries quickly with Copilot's concise AI summaries at the top of Outlook search results. Users can dig deeper by opening Copilot chat directly from the Copilot summary card.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Critique in Researcher
items.description: Responses are generated by GPT and Claude working together, with GPT drafting an initial response and Claude reviewing for increased response accuracy, completeness, and citation integrity.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher Council
items.description: Council in Researcher runs multiple leading AI models from different providers in parallel in one place, so you can quickly compare outputs and see consensus vs. conflict) to make high-stakes decisions with greater confidence—without switching tools.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized Default Mark and Notify Email Template
items.description: Enabling localization for the default Mark and Notify email template used in admin review and automation flows for user reported messages. This ensures end users receive review outcome notifications in their preferred language, improving understanding, trust, and participation in email reporting within Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
items.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updated handling of entity inserts in the Copilot Chat input box
items.description: Starting mid-August 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat will update entity insertion so entity names no longer appear as text in the input box, creating cleaner prompts. This change is default for all tenants, requires no admin action, and affects all commercial cloud users.

items.title: (Updated) Clearer RSVP selection in Outlook Mobile
items.description: Outlook Mobile will highlight users' selected RSVP (Yes, Maybe, No) for meetings, improving visibility. Rollout starts mid-September 2026 and completes by mid-October 2026, affecting all iOS and Android users worldwide, GCC, and GCC High tenants. No admin action needed; feature enabled by default.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Stricter external access controls for federated chats
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new PowerShell controls by late September 2026 to enforce stricter external access and mutual federation policies in federated group chats. These controls, disabled by default, help admins limit chat participation to approved external users and ensure mutual federation compliance, with automatic removal of non-compliant participants.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft SharePoint: Restricted content discovery enhancements for Copilot and Microsoft 365 search
items.description: Microsoft is enhancing SharePoint's Restricted Content Discovery (RCD) to limit content visibility in Copilot and Microsoft 365 search, starting late July 2026. Files on RCD-enabled sites won't appear in AI-powered search or Copilot, and AI entry points will be removed, ensuring better compliance and content control.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Entra ID SSPR will require registered authentication methods starting November 9, 2026
items.description: Starting November 9, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID SSPR will require explicitly registered authentication methods for password reset verification, disallowing directory-sourced contact info unless registered. A registration campaign begins October 5, 2026. Organizations must ensure users register methods to avoid reset failures.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
items.description: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: View and manage auto attendant shared voicemails directly in the Queues app
items.description: Calls to an Auto Attendant that are routed to voicemail will now appear directly within Queues app. This enables organizations to manage shared Auto Attendant voicemails in a centralized experience, making it easier for teams to track, triage, and respond to customer messages.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification messages for recording and transcription in calls
items.description: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
items.description: Call delegation in Teams now includes new controls that give delegators greater privacy and control during active calls. Delegators can lock an ongoing call to prevent delegates from joining or resuming the call and can optionally enable warning tones that notify participants when a delegate joins or resumes a call.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
items.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations. This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
items.description: Large file sharing in Teams today introduces blocking behavior, forcing users to wait for uploads to complete and disrupting real-time collaboration. To improve productivity and reduce perceived latency, we are introducing asynchronous file uploads. This allows users to continue sending messages while the file uploads in the background, enabling a more seamless and uninterrupted collaboration experience.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
items.description: Microsoft Teams automatically organizes your chats with new built in sections that help reduce clutter and keep conversations easy to find. Muted chats (on by default) are grouped together in a dedicated area, while meeting chats (off by default) can be collected into a single section for quick access. You’re always in control, as each section can be turned on or off based on your preferences. The new Meeting chats…
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
items.description: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Specifically, the experience enables administrators to leverage the organization-supported logo already managed in the Microsoft Admin Center theming settings and display it in the footer of the Chat screen, paired with a fixed label: “…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Slash commands for apps
items.description: You can now interact with your favorite apps directly from Teams chat and channels compose box using slash commands. Type / and start interacting with Apps and Agents, invoke workflows and more.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will support real-time Interpreter agent for up to nine languages, enabling multilingual meetings with voice simulation. Available late August 2026, it requires a Teams Rooms Pro license, includes 20 hours of interpretation monthly, and offers admin controls via Teams meeting policies. No action required.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard
items.description: Microsoft Viva introduces targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard, enabling authorized users to send Viva Pulse surveys to predefined Copilot user groups dynamically based on dashboard data. The feature rolls out from mid-August to late September 2026, is enabled by default, and can be managed by admins.

items.title: SharePoint Pages: Flexible Section Authoring Improvements
items.description: SharePoint Pages will enhance Flexible Sections with visual and persistent layout guides, easier resizing, and the ability to convert standard sections without losing content. These improvements, rolling out worldwide in August 2026, aim to simplify page authoring and ensure consistent layouts across devices. No admin action is needed.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will receive a modernized Gallery view in mid-August 2026, aligning it with Windows. Updates include consistent participant tile ratios, video prioritization, stable gallery behavior, and new admin controls. No action is required before rollout; admins can configure settings post-update.

items.title: UPDATED: Catalog search functionality might be unavailable or return incomplete results
(Updated) Use OneDrive-stored user-defined custom skills in PowerPoint Copilot (Mac)
items.product: Microsoft 365 apps, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
items.description: PowerPoint Copilot for Mac will support personal custom skills stored in OneDrive, allowing users to upload skill folders with a SKILL.md file. These skills appear in Copilot's Skills menu and can be managed individually via a new Manage Skills pane. Rollout starts late July 2026.

items.title: (Updated) Use OneDrive stored user defined custom skills in PowerPoint Copilot (web)
items.product: Microsoft 365 for the web, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
items.description: PowerPoint Copilot on the web will support personal custom skills stored in OneDrive, visible only to the user. Users can upload skill folders with a SKILL.md file and manage skills via a new interface. Rollout starts late July 2026, requiring no admin action but recommending governance and training updates.

items.title: (Updated) Use OneDrive-stored user-defined custom skills in PowerPoint Copilot (Desktop)
items.description: PowerPoint Copilot will support personal custom skills stored in OneDrive, appearing in the Copilot Skills menu. Users can upload skill folders with a SKILL.md file, enable/disable skills via a new Manage Skills interface, enhancing customization without admin action. Rollout completes by early August 2026.

items.title: Power Platform - New Continuous Access Evaluation (CAE) rollout nearing completion
(Updated) Copilot Notebooks: Suggested artifacts for faster content creation
items.description: Copilot Notebooks will proactively suggest relevant Word, Excel, and PowerPoint artifacts based on notebook content and Microsoft 365 context, enhancing content creation without extra prompts. Available by default from late August 2026, no admin setup is needed. Future support will include PDFs and Pages.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot app: Branded footer customization
items.description: Starting August 2026, admins can add their organization's logo as a branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app to confirm a trusted environment. This feature is off by default, requires admin setup in the Microsoft 365 admin center, and applies organization-wide using the default theme logo.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. Rollout starts early September 2026, completing by end of October. Users can enable, disable, or reorder these sections; no admin action is needed.

items.title: Microsoft Planner: Task details side pane experience
items.description: Microsoft Planner will introduce a task details side pane by mid-August 2026, allowing users to view and edit tasks without leaving their main view. This feature, enabled by default on web and Teams, supports key task fields, remembers user preferences, and requires no admin action.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Enhancing how we handle promotional mail
items.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will tag promotional emails as “promotions” and can auto-move them to a Promotions folder, learning user preferences over time. Public preview starts mid-April 2026; general availability begins late July 2026. Admins can configure settings, and users can train the system by moving messages.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft OneNote: Multimodal recording in Copilot Notebooks on Windows
items.description: Microsoft is introducing multimodal capture in OneNote Copilot Notebooks on Windows, enabling users to record audio, images, and notes together. Copilot generates summaries, decisions, and action items from captured content. The feature rolls out worldwide from late August to mid-September 2026, requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and can be disabled by admins.

When relevant results are found, a banner is shown with a link to explore those work results with Microsoft 365 Copilot. This builds on the existing experience already available on Bing and extends it to Google, helping users seamlessly access work-related inf…

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
items.description: Administrators can choose a severity threshold and receive alerts when a new Edge update includes security fixes that meet or exceed that level, including zero day fixes. This helps organizations quickly identify updates that may require attention, while avoiding unnecessary notifications for routine releases.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill
items.description: For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver’s licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Tracking prevention when browsing InPrivate
items.description: Microsoft Edge is unifying the tracking prevention experience for non-InPrivate and InPrivate browsing windows. Microsoft Edge will use the same tracking prevention setting as a normal browsing window when in InPrivate mode.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.description: Users in GCC-M will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Retirement of custom CSS positioning properties in custom branding
items.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire support for custom CSS positioning properties in company branding starting October 2026 to enhance security and phishing resistance. Existing users must remove these properties by then, as no migration path exists. Branding elements remain visible but may revert to default placement.

items.title: Updates to the Windows Insider Program web experience
(Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot: Schedule prompts in Agent Builder
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Agent Builder will allow users to create scheduled workflows that run prompts automatically on various recurrence patterns. This feature, expected to rollout September 2026, enables automation of routine tasks per user, respects existing policies, and offers full user control over workflows. No admin action is needed.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Update the Teams mobile app to maintain Calendar functionality
items.description: To maintain Calendar functionality in Microsoft Teams mobile on iOS and Android, users must update to the latest Teams app by early October 2026. Older versions will lose calendar access. Admins should ensure updates, inform users, and configure management tools accordingly. This change does not affect desktop or web clients.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft PowerPoint: Access your organization's brand templates in PowerPoint
items.description: Microsoft PowerPoint will enable users with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) on Windows to access organizational brand templates directly from Backstage starting late August 2026. Organizations must configure Brand kits and designate brand managers to publish templates, ensuring consistent branding without removing existing Organizational Asset Library templates.

items.title: (Updated) Upcoming Conditional Access change: Improved enforcement for policies with resource exclusions
items.description: Starting June 15, 2026, Conditional Access policies targeting All resources with exclusions will be enforced for sign-ins requesting only certain OIDC or directory scopes. Some users may face new challenges like MFA. Most organizations need no action, but custom apps requesting only these scopes should be evaluated.

Microsoft Teams: Manage auto attendant shared voicemails in the Queues app

items.description: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. SMB Admins can use Microsoft 365 Admin Agent in Microsoft Teams to complete common admin tasks and get guidance on critical setup actions. Admin Agent can add users and assign licenses on behalf of the admin, as well as provide guidance on key SMB related topics such as organisation setup, security settings, and pa…

items.title: Outlook: Clear & Flag Actions in New Outlook
items.description: We’re introducing new rule actions in the new Outlook for Web and Windows to give users greater flexibility and control. This includes Clear Categories, Clear Flag, Complete Flag, and Flag Message, enabling more precise automation of message organization and follow‑up workflows. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Expanded Conditions for Conditional Formatting in the New Outlook for Web and Windows
items.description: The new Outlook for web and Windows now offers expanded Conditional Formatting options, allowing you to highlight emails based on size, read/unread status, presence of attachments, flag settings, categories, or importance. These enhanced rules make it easier to identify critical messages at a glance and visually organize your folders. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft 365 Copilot: Get suggested edits from Copilot in your Copilot Pages
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will introduce AI-generated suggested edits in Copilot Pages to improve content clarity and quality. Rolling out from early June 2026 (Frontier) and end of August 2026 (general), users can request and apply writing feedback directly within pages, with no extra configuration needed.

items.title: (Update) Ending support for Setup Assistant (legacy) auth method in ADE and Apple Configurator for iOS/iPadOS and macOS
items.description: Intune will end support for Setup Assistant (legacy) authentication in iOS/iPadOS and macOS ADE, and Apple Configurator Setup Assistant enrollment for iOS/iPadOS devices with user device affinity with the October 2610 release. They will be replaced with Setup Assistant and Apple Configurator Company Portal enrollment, using modern authentication for improved security. Existing devices remain enrolled; profiles will…

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Targeted Audience Surveys
items.description: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users. Audiences update automatically using Insights data and respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function, with privacy protected through population-level reporting only. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.

items.title: SharePoint: Viva Connections multi-home site management moving to SharePoint admin center
items.description: Viva Connections multi-home site management is moving from the Microsoft 365 admin center (MAC) to the SharePoint Admin Center (SPAC). Administrators will be able to create and manage multiple Home sites, configure audience targeting, manage home site priority order, and remove Home sites directly from SPAC. Existing entry points in the Microsoft 365 admin center will direct administrators to the new SPAC experience…

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Rolling out Custom branding in Engage
items.description: Engage is rolling out Custom Branding, a new admin-led capability that lets organizations define a customized, tenant-wide visual identity across the Engage web and mobile apps. Engage-level admins can configure a brand name, add large and small logos, and a theme color that is applied consistently for all users in the tenant. Branding is managed from the new Brand Center in the Viva Engage admin center and helps or…

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with…

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
items.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated Copilot Answers
items.description: Copilot Answers in Copilot Search (in the M365 Copilot App on web and desktop) will provide more concise responses and more prominently highlight the ability to continue in the conversation in Copilot chat on the right-hand sidebar.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: When a Teams Rooms on Windows acts as an organizer, co-organizer or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Teams: User uploaded custom background images for the new VDI solution for Microsoft Teams
items.description: With this new feature, users on the new VDI solution for Teams can blur their background, choose a Teams virtual background, or replace their background entirely with any image they want by uploading it through the "Video effects and Settings" option.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection for BYOD spaces
items.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing shared display mode and enhanced peripheral detection for BYOD meeting spaces to improve meeting join experience and privacy. Rollout begins late July 2026. Administrators gain new reporting and device health insights in Teams Pro Management portal, with options to opt out of data collection. Users can disable automatic meeting room mode.

items.title: Microsoft SharePoint Embedded: Update to driveItem.webUrl behavior
items.description: Microsoft is updating SharePoint Embedded's driveItem.webUrl to return browser launch URLs instead of stable file locations. Use driveItemId for stable identifiers. Changes roll out from mid-August 2026, with a temporary opt-out until February 22, 2027. Review and update applications accordingly.

items.title: 90-Day Reminder: AD FS DKM container ACL hardening begins in October 2026
(Updated) Microsoft Purview compliance portal: View-only role management enhancements
items.description: Microsoft Purview now allows Global Reader and Security Reader roles to view role assignments and scopes in Purview and Defender portals with read-only access, enhancing compliance transparency without changing permissions. This feature rolls out globally from late August to September 2026 and requires no user action.

items.title: (Updated) Access your brand assets in PowerPoint
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint will provide native access to brand assets (colors, logos, icons, images) via a dedicated brand pane starting mid-July 2026. Licensed users can create or use official brand kits for on-brand presentations, with admins able to manage branding centrally. No action is needed for default use.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Windows console
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will support ad-hoc room reservations directly from the console, requiring a Teams Rooms Pro license. Rollout is from July to September 2026, varying by region. The feature is enabled by default, with admin controls available, and no action is needed before rollout.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Chat panel opens by default in Gallery view on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will open the meeting chat panel by default in Gallery view starting late June 2026. Admins can configure this setting, users can close the chat with one tap, and no action is required. Notify users and update documentation as needed.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams Rooms: Private chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars
items.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in structured meetings and webinars, offering two chat options: private coordination among key participants and a chat for all attendees. Rollout begins late October 2026, completing mid-November 2026.

items.title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Experience improvements to Voice apps configuration wizard in Teams admin center
items.description: Microsoft is updating the Auto Attendant and Call Queue configuration wizard in the Teams admin center to streamline setup, improve navigation, and enhance performance.
