items.description: You can now ask Copilot in chat and channels to respond to questions regarding a conversation in a specific time period, for example: last month.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams meeting recordings will be saved to meeting organizer’s OneDrive for Business
items.description: With this change Teams meeting recordings will be saved to the meeting organizer’s OneDrive for Business instead of to the OneDrive for Business folder of the person who initiated the recording. This improves the compliance of recordings as meeting organizers can then manage access permissions and recording file management.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Town Hall Graph APIs
items.description: The Teams town hall Graph APIs allow users to create, update, and delete town hall events.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Improved Resume OOB Built-in Trainable Classifier
items.description: The new enhanced Resume Classifier is equipped with better technology. It has a higher accuracy and is able to identify resumes that were not previously detected. The classifier has been upgraded to handle challenging False Negative and False Positive cases.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Group chat profile picture
items.description: You will have a better way to reflect your team and group chat topic, with custom pictures. Group chat members can upload an image or use pre-selected illustrations and emojis, adding a layer of inclusivity and expression to their chat.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Export Q&A Questions
items.description: Event organizers can now export questions that attendees asked as a .csv file to better understand the questions asked and general sentiment in a town hall or webinar.

items.title: Outlook: New Outlook for Windows - Search tasks using Microsoft To Do
items.description: Search across your tasks lists using the Microsoft To Do module in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: OneDrive for Business available in classic Outlook for Windows
items.description: Quickly access your OneDrive without having to leave Outlook! Users can find and use the OneDrive app in classic Outlook for Windows, for a consistent and fast experience.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Playlist Card on Viva Connections Dashboard
items.description: This feature allows tenant admins to create a card for a playlist to be accessed from the Viva Connections Dashboard.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Use sensitivity labels in Microsoft 365 apps when connected experiences are disabled
items.product: Microsoft Information Protection, Microsoft Purview compliance portal, Microsoft 365 app
items.description: Your organization can now disable connected experiences for privacy concerns without impacting data security policies such as sensitivity labels. Services associated with Microsoft Purview (e.g. sensitivity labels and rights management) are no longer controlled by policy settings to manage privacy controls for Microsoft 365 Apps. Instead, these services will rely on their existing security admin controls in Purview…

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Use the Egress API to access all “My Learning” records
items.description: The Egress API can be used by learners to view their My Learning records and corresponding course details.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Longer documents can be summarized in chat
items.description: Copilot in Word will be able to completely summarize documents that it could only partially summarize before. The upper limit is increasing to about four times more words.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Private Line on Teams Phone Devices
items.description: Teams phone devices will support Private line, a new functionality for Teams Phone that allows you to enable a private second phone number for a select set of users so they can receive inbound calls directly, by passing delegates, admins, or assistants. Calls to the private line are distinguished by a unique notification and ringtone.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: People app on Teams Phone Devices
items.description: An updated People app on Teams phone devices will provide a simplified and faster experience to help users manage contacts easily.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Explicit consent recording meeting policy support on Teams Phone Devices
items.description: When explicit consent recording meeting policy is applied, a notification will pop-up when the recording or transcription is initiated requesting consent of participants on Teams phone devices.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Security settings in the Microsoft Edge management service
items.description: The Microsoft Edge management service will provide admins with a dedicated experience to manage specific settings that help improve the security posture of their managed browser instances.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Attach files from SharePoint Sites in the mobile app
items.description: Users will be able to browse, multiselect and attach files from SharePoint Sites to a chat or channel conversation in the mobile app.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Add links to content in featured set
items.description: Global administrators/knowledge administrators can now add links to content sets in Viva Learning. These links can direct users to content stored internally with services like SharePoint and Stream or found online through YouTube, Vimeo, and other sources. The capability to add links to content allows admins to add content found online to featured sets, in addition to formal learning courses from connected providers.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva for AI Transformation pre-built campaign in Viva Amplify
items.description: Pre-drafted publications, campaign objectives and key messages designed to communicate how to leverage Microsoft Viva for AI transformation.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention for endpoints - Restrict unintentional sharing to unallowed cloud apps and services (macOS)
items.description: Ability to restrict unintentional sharing of sensitive items to unallowed cloud apps and services in macOS.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data loss prevention (DLP) support for trainable classifiers (U.S. Government clouds)
items.description: Trainable classifiers can be added as a condition for data loss prevention (DLP) policies, and enhanced templates and default policies will leverage trainable classifiers. Additionally, classifier-related information and alerts will appear within Activity explorer.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Show/hide discover feed
items.description: You will now have the flexibility to show or hide (turn off/turn on) discover feed. Users can access this new toggle from the general settings section.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Simplifying the personal app header
items.description: Microsoft Teams personal apps will start showing a new simplified header bar on Microsoft Teams desktop and web clients. With this change, the "About" tab and other utility actions will be moved to the overflow menu. In addition, the "Chat" tab will be moved to a right-hand side panel for apps that support it.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Browse OneDrive and SharePoint folders to find files to ground prompts in Copilot with Graph-grounded chat
items.description: Browse OneDrive and SharePoint folders to find files for grounding prompts in Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Trainable Classifiers in Server Side Auto-labeling
items.description: Trainable Classifiers are now available for server side auto-labeling policies in exchange, OneDrive and SharePoint. In addition to the 15 Classifiers that are already available, we have now launched 23 more Trainable Classifier to detect sensitive content such as IP and Trade Secrets, sensitive documents pertaining to important business functions such as Finance, Sales, HR, and Material Non Public Information.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Microsoft 365 Backup
items.description: Microsoft 365 Backup Service is a product offering spanning across the OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange Online services that provides customers with a consistent, cross product solution, to recover their M365 data from cataclysmic events such as: at scale ransomware attacks, or malicious/accidental data deletion/corruption by end users. Microsoft 365 Backup Service is available on a pay-as-you-go basis and can be…

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Passkey authentication in brokered Microsoft apps on Android
items.description: Microsoft Entra ID users can now use a passkey to sign into Microsoft apps on Android devices where an authentication broker like Microsoft Authenticator or Microsoft Intune Company Portal is installed.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Quick Links Card on Viva Connections Dashboard
items.description: This feature helps tenant admins add a card with a list of curated quick links for users on the Viva Connections Dashboard.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Amplify - Video templates
items.description: Create and highlight videocentric publications, like meeting content or executive messages, with the new video templates in Viva Amplify; this presents videos that are inline, playable, and beautiful.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Amplify - Easier to find your most recent templates
items.description: Updates to the Viva Amplify template display include showing the most recently modified templates on the campaign overview page for easy access and separating the Viva Amplify provided templates from the user-saved campaign templates.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Lab is now available in Teams on iOS and Android
items.description: Explore and use suggested Copilot prompts in Copilot Lab in the Teams app on iOS and Android.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Copilot Academy support for additional external content
items.description: This feature includes the ability to support external content including Copilot Lab resources

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Adaptive Protection and Conditional Access
items.description: Organizations can use insider risk levels in their Conditional Access policies. This includes minor experience changes in the Adaptive Protection tab in Insider Risk Management, including adding total counts for Conditional Access policies that use Adaptive Protection and new user insights in the user activity timeline when a user is added or removed from an insider risk level. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Managem…

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Audit - New logs for Audit activities
items.description: Activities performed by users like submitting an Audit search query, viewing and exporting Audit logs, and deleting search history within the Purview Audit feature will now begin to generate Audit logs.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Expanded support for device-bound passkeys in Microsoft Entra ID
items.description: Microsoft Entra ID will add support for device-bound passkeys stored on computers and mobile devices as an authentication method in preview, in addition to the existing support for FIDO2 security keys. This enables users to perform phishing-resistant authentication using the devices that they already have. The existing FIDO2 authentication methods policy and end user experiences will be changed to support this previ…
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Support for static and adaptive policy scopes for auto-apply retention labels targeting SITs in Exchange
items.description: Auto-apply retention labels targeting sensitive information types in Exchange will now support static include/exclude and adaptive policy scopes. Previously admins could only target all Exchange mailboxes.

items.title: OneDrive: Admins can configure a group policy to block specific folders from OneDrive Sync
items.description: In addition to being able to configure a group policy to exclude specific files or file extensions from Syncing with OneDrive, admins can now exclude folders as well. End-users will be able to see the excluded folders in the Sync configuration applied to them via their OneDrive Advanced Settings.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: False positive email release from Quarantine through threat explorer, email summary panel, advanced hunting, and custom detection email entity page take action
items.description: SecOps can now mange False positives and take move to inbox (i.e. release) quarantined messages from Threat explorer, advanced hunting, custom detection and Email entity page without the need to tab out to the Quarantine portal to take the action.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: School Connection – Providing access to parents via their phone number
items.description: The School Connection app in Microsoft Teams (mobile) empowers parents and guardians to engage, support, and monitor their student's learning at school. This release enables a parent/guardian to get access to their child’s profile in School Connection if they login to Teams (mobile) with their phone number and the school has registered that phone number as a parent/guardian contact. Additionally, a parent/guardian w…

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot assisted goal authoring with Context IQ grounding
items.description: When generating goals, users will be able to add more than one file from context IQ suggestions as references in their prompts to Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft 365 admin centers – Manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and Microsoft 365 App
items.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App will be able to apply their changes across all three clients (Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App). Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App; simi…

items.title: Microsoft Teams: File Image preview in chats and channels
items.description: When you share documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF) in chat or channel conversation, you can see a thumbnail image of the file in the thread. This lets you preview the file’s content without opening it and find the file you need quickly.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Change background while recording on phone
items.description: You can record a video clip with your phone camera and switch your background to any picture you want or make it blurry. With this feature, you can record yourself anywhere and share it with coworkers in your Teams chat or channel.
items.cloudInstances: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High, DoD

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Search in Viva Connections on iOS and Android tablet
items.description: This adds a search entry point and a new tailored experience for Viva Connection users on iOS and Android tablets.
